answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary defense where agents lock capital to validate transactions. Like sediment hardening into shale under pressure, staked value forms a resistant layer. An attacker climbing the knoll of network influence faces a prohibitive cost, as acquiring sufficient stake to outvote peers requires massive capital outlay. This barrier forces adversaries toward a dangerous ledge where the financial penalty of malicious behavior outweighs any potential illicit gain from a Sybil cluster.
